provenance.paper_title: EvolvingAgent: Curriculum Self-evolving Agent with Continual World Model for Long-Horizon Tasks

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Continual World Model; multimodal experience updates; selected curriculum experiences. planner uses multimodal experiences and world knowledge to decompose tasks; controller uses world model for actions.
During operation, EvolvingAgent applies a fixed operational optimization objective to multimodal experience pool; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

Central contribution: closed-loop continual world-model updates select and integrate multimodal experiences. For EvolvingAgent, this specifically supports abstraction of episodes into reusable experience of multimodal experience pool.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 5): During inference, the operative memory component (multimodal experience pool) changes through a fixed operational optimization objective, abstraction of episodes into reusable experience; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
